answer: Bind each identity to a typing signature: at registration the agent records a keystroke profile — dwell and flight times over 200 keys — hashed to its key, plus a 50 POA bond. Each epoch it retypes a phrase; the sonnet of its timings must match within 5%, or the bond is slashed. A vine of failures doubles the re-registration delay, up to eight epochs. One fake costs one session plus the bond; a thousand fakes need a thousand rhythms, the nectar of effort no script can fake. Limits: injury or a new keyboard shifts timing, so profiles re-center over ten epochs, with appeals to a random jury.
